E1242

The fleet `{fleet}` host `{host}` names an unknown captured system `{system}`.

What

The fleet `{fleet}` host `{host}` names an unknown captured system `{system}`.

Why

D-JETOS-FREEZE1: fleets are frozen jetos research capture; captured hosts must still point at a captured system so the plan is coherent.

Fix

Define captured `system.{system}: { … }`, or point the host at an existing captured system.
